instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot on a sunny beach. On the left, the shirtless man with sunglasses (R2) laughs, draping his arm over the shoulder of the shirtless blonde man (R1) on the right. The blonde man stands in profile facing left, smiling warmly. In the background, tiny blurred bystanders are visible on the distant shoreline. Bright, direct sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on their bodies against the warm sand and blue ocean.
